verdict.rationale: Docs confirm individual subscribers can opt out of having their code data used for AI model training, but this is narrower than opting out of telemetry/usage tracking broadly, and no evidence describes a general telemetry opt-out toggle. Community commentary (comm-5) even notes agreeing to 'additional telemetry terms' during a preview with no opt-out mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting, documentation distinguishing telemetry from training-data opt-out, and independent confirmation that opting out actually stops telemetry collection.
